reports.title: Denver, Colorado: November 3, 2026 - Liberty Global Ltd. announces its Q3 2026 financial results.

lines: We anticipate ending 2026 with ~$1.8B4 of corporate cash, with a further $100m of share buybacks expected in Q4.
•Property and equipment additions of $98.9 million, -34.8% YoY on a reported basis and -33.7% on a rebased basis, reflecting lower capital intensity in line with Telenet's full year outlook
